body:
I have very very long history with trippy drugs and I know my body pretty well and have never luckily died. Methamphetamine & heroin/ oxys being my downfall as a late teen and all through my 20s and only got right when I was around 27 because if I kept getting high I was going to die. Crystal knocked me in the dirt worse than anything else on earth after chronic use for 2.5 years straight which went by very very fast. Plenty of hallucinogenic stuff in there to can't tell what's the strongest thing I've ingested was probably DOM or DOI tied up with acid and psilocybin & I've had full on out of body experiences from MDA tablets & sassafrass.
I no longer live in my childhood home but this took place in a very familiar place and I've smoked salvia leaf and extract (separately) several dozens of times, Salvia is very strange.
I was hanging out with a bunch of my old buddies from high school long ago. Back when Salvia extract was sold in stores we bought some brand that had a purple monkey on it is all I remember. The substance looked like dark clumps of an off-black mushroom spore. Almost looked like something I would scrape out of a bowl of really dark colored resin.
To get as much smoke as possible, we had glass back when but we wanted to get as big a hit as we could, also keeping in mind Salvia was the first psyche I had tried. This isn't my 1st experience.  I couldn't tell you when this happened but it was the most intense. Anyway we wanted the most smoke,  so we attached a bunch of cylindrical objects and duct tape and hot glued them to an old 2ft-er acrylic ugly ass green bong.
After we attached all this shit to the top of this bong and the bowl was all the way sticking from the bottom, didn't carry much water we were gonna get a lot of smoke. Someone else would have to kneel down to light the bowl because this contraption was too high tech for anyone to use on their own unless one can click a lighter with the toes.
Anyway I remember sitting on a sofa in my room.
There's a bed in front of me and a television and a large tarp with some arabic
about Allah on it. And to each of my sides are a very nice trio of young man named kiyak, ju, and barnabas, these were my friends.
Anytime this bong hit, the smoke was hot and would even burn my damn lips.
Barnabus carried the torch that sent six feet of insanely 'milky' smoke built up and it shot into my lungs and all I felt as I inhaled was a "wet" slurping noise from my head to my toes and vice versa.
The room began to dim very quickly and change into what looked like one of those 1000 piece puzzles but if I took a hammer and beat the shit out of it first and broke it all, it was like that. And I remember the last bit of reality I grasped before "falling down quickly" is the way I can describe, it was like I was falling off a waterfall and the waves kicking the shit out of me from left to right. The room began to glow as well. All this happened in about the first 2 seconds all of the smoke hadn't even made it to my lungs yet and I was losing it already and time was spiraling out of control. The last of the human world left was as if the room had shrank into a triangle and me and my friends were stuck in the middle of it and I let out a pure unadulterated involuntary shriek of absolute horror and excitement at once!
The last thing I saw before I "spun backwards into myself" was Barnabus laughing at me and it looked like he vomited at the same time. Next I know I feel completely disconnected from my brain and my eyes, but my body felt like it was made of glass or crystal, it was a fragile feeling but extremely powerful. I then felt pain all through my skin. I get this every time I smoke salvia and I think its actually a head-rush type thing.
This stuff was different, I literally went somewhere else and nothing became recognizable. I felt sharp "wind" is the only real way to describe this and I've never heard anyone else say that their skin has "hurt" from salvia but mine sure did.
It felt like pins and needles all over, all the way through every direction and orifice of my skin. It felt as if wind was blowing against me very roughly and the wind was peppered with shards of broken glass or small razors, it felt like knives slicing across my skin and I thought it might be my clothes.
It felt like pins and needles all over, all the way through every direction and orifice of my skin. It felt as if wind was blowing against me very roughly and the wind was peppered with shards of broken glass or small razors, it felt like knives slicing across my skin and I thought it might be my clothes.
I did think it was my clothes and I remember somehow standing up and being told to sit down but I couldn't listen at all. I didn't even know who was talking. I just heard the voice, the man was missing. I walked into the bathroom, stripped down naked and sat on the floor and realized this actually wasn't helping and I still felt in pain and it began to piss me off as I slowly begin to drift back to my already pretty warped reality just from being me.
But I got dressed and left the bathroom and sat back down and the comedown/ afterglow from salvia leaves me feeling a burst of energy and a long lasting anxiety relief. Sometimes even slight sedation.
I drifted back to reality from a cloud descending from the eye of the sky-womb as I heard the slight echoes, pitches of angels singing in a bright choir behind my head but it was audible. I heard some trumpets in there and a train engine at one point as well.
Anyway that's all. God bless.
